# Add a trusted SEPA beneficiary

Add a <Term id="trusted-beneficiary">trusted beneficiary</Term> for <Term id="credit-transfer">SEPA Credit Transfers</Term> with the API.

## Add a trusted beneficiary {#guide-add}

1. Call the `addTrustedSepaBeneficiary` mutation.
1. Add your `accountId` (line 4). The trusted beneficiary is linked to this account.
1. Add your SEPA beneficiary's name and <Term id="ibans">IBAN</Term> (lines 5-6).
1. Add the `AddTrustedSepaBeneficiarySuccessPayload` success payload with the `trustedBeneficiary` > `id` (line 13) and the consent URL (lines 14-17): `statusInfo` > `TrustedBeneficiaryConsentPendingStatusInfo` > `consent` > `consentUrl`. Send the `consentUrl` to your user.
1. Add rejections (not shown).

### Mutation {#mutation-add}

<a href="https://explorer.swan.io?%3D%3D&tab=api" className="explorer-badge">Open in API Explorer</a>

```graphql {2,4,5-6,12-17} showLineNumbers
mutation AddBeneficiary {
  addTrustedSepaBeneficiary(
    input: {
      accountId: "$ACCOUNT_ID"
      iban: "$TRUSTED_BENEFICIARY_IBAN"
      name: "$TRUSTED_BENEFICIARY_NAME"
      consentRedirectUrl: "$REDIRECT_URL"
    }
  ) {
    ... on AddTrustedSepaBeneficiarySuccessPayload {
      __typename
      trustedBeneficiary {
        id
        statusInfo {
          ... on TrustedBeneficiaryConsentPendingStatusInfo {
            consent {
              consentUrl
            }
          }
        }
      }
    }
  }
}
```

import Environments from '../../../../_shared/partials/_environments.mdx';

<Environments />

### Payload {#payload-add}

The success payload returns the new trusted beneficiary's ID (line 6) and the consent URL to send to your user (line 9).

```json {6,9} showLineNumbers
{
  "data": {
    "addTrustedSepaBeneficiary": {
      "__typename": "AddTrustedSepaBeneficiarySuccessPayload",
      "trustedBeneficiary": {
        "id": "$TRUSTED_BENEFICIARY_ID",
        "statusInfo": {
          "consent": {
            "consentUrl": "https://identity.swan.io/consent?consentId=$YOUR_CONSENT_ID&env=Sandbox"
          }
        }
      }
    }
  }
}
```

## Save a beneficiary when initiating a transfer {#guide-save}

1. Call the `initiateCreditTransfers` mutation.
1. Add the `amount` and `consentRedirectUrl`.
1. Add your `accountId`.
1. Add your SEPA beneficiary's name and IBAN (lines 7-8).
1. Choose `true` for the boolean `save` (line 10).
1. Add the success payload.
1. Add rejections (not shown).

### Mutation {#mutation-save}

<a href="https://explorer.swan.io?%3D&tab=api" className="explorer-badge">Open in API Explorer</a>

```graphql {2,6-8,10,14} showLineNumbers
mutation SaveBeneficiary {
  initiateCreditTransfers(
    input: {
      creditTransfers: {
        amount: { value: "200", currency: "EUR" }
        sepaBeneficiary: {
          iban: "$TRUSTED_BENEFICIARY_IBAN"
          name: "$TRUSTED_BENEFICIARY_NAME"
          isMyOwnIban: false
          save: true
        }
      }
      consentRedirectUrl: "$REDIRECT_URL"
      accountId: "$ACCOUNT_ID"
    }
  ) {
    ... on InitiateCreditTransfersSuccessPayload {
      __typename
      payment {
        id
      }
    }
  }
}
```

### Payload {#payload-save}

import SavedBeneficiaryPayload from '../partials/_saved-beneficiary-payload.mdx';

<SavedBeneficiaryPayload />

```json showLineNumbers
{
  "data": {
    "initiateCreditTransfers": {
      "__typename": "InitiateCreditTransfersSuccessPayload",
      "payment": {
        "id": "$PAYMENT_ID"
      }
    }
  }
}
```
